# Emigration Pro

> Emigration Pro helps U.S. citizens plan a move abroad. It provides a structured
> country-match assessment and sells personalized relocation reports covering visa
> routes, cost of living, housing, healthcare access and tax considerations for a
> specific destination city.

Emigration Pro is a research and planning service, not a law firm or immigration
consultancy. It does not file applications or provide legal advice. Reports are
research summaries intended to help someone decide where to move and what the move
would involve; visa rules change and should be confirmed against official government
sources before acting.

Audience: U.S. citizens and residents considering relocation abroad, including
retirees, remote workers and self-employed people.

## Core pages

- [Home](https://emigrationpro.com/): What the service does and how the assessment and report fit together.
- [Country-match assessment](https://emigrationpro.com/assessment): Free structured questionnaire covering budget, profession, age, family situation, climate and lifestyle preferences; returns matching destination countries.
- [Popular countries for American expats](https://emigrationpro.com/best-countries): Overview of Portugal, Spain, Mexico, Costa Rica, Germany and Canada for U.S. movers.
- [Sample relocation report](https://emigrationpro.com/sample-report): Partial example of the personalized report, showing the depth and section structure.
- [About](https://emigrationpro.com/about): Who runs Emigration Pro and how the research is produced.

## Guidance and income

- [Earn abroad](https://emigrationpro.com/earn-abroad): Building sustainable self-employed income while living overseas.
- [Living wage online business](https://emigrationpro.com/living-wage-business): Online business models that can cover living costs abroad.

## Editorial

- [Blog](https://emigrationpro.com/blog): Articles on visa requirements, cost of living, healthcare and country-specific relocation logistics.
